selected_style.family: Inter, a contemporary neutral sans-serif already bundled with Portfolio
selected_style.weight: 800; one line; restrained tracking; four words maximum
selected_style.case: uppercase for short-form scanability, without condensed or arcade letterforms
selected_style.color: warm white over the calm navy dusk region; no gradient fill
selected_style.effects: no outline, glow, bevel, extrusion, trajectory, arrow, or decorative curve; only a small soft shadow for local contrast
selected_style.placement: upper-left calm sky, outside the actual gameplay proof and player/ball focal area

rejected_styles.style: condensed black arcade display with gold-orange gradient, stroke, glow, rings, and impact vectors
rejected_styles.reason: No matching type treatment appears in either current topic comparator; it would repeat the rejected dated game-poster direction and compete with real product proof.

rejected_styles.style: default-font caption pasted beside a rectangular screenshot
rejected_styles.reason: Creates a generic split-card template and separates the teaching idea from the action.

rejected_styles.style: creator-logo, reaction face, fabricated score, or drawn trajectory
rejected_styles.reason: Not needed to explain the actual product pixels and risks implying evidence or identity that is not present.

selection_logic: Both selected official YouTube comparables are topic/audience adjacent and omit added display text. Their common signal is that real activity carries the thumbnail at feed size. The selected four-word neutral-sans line is a deliberately restrained editorial cue, not a claimed winning font; the real KickLab screenshot remains the sole product-proof layer. Comparable views and likes are captured context only and have zero typography-performance weight.

performance_evidence.baseline_method: Required baseline: median 30-day-equivalent views for at least four standard-length videos published within the prior 90 days on the same channel, normalized by each video age and matched for topic/audience; exclude Shorts, paid promotions, gifted-product integrations, and hosted-travel outliers.
performance_evidence.formula: matched-style comparable views normalized per day / same-channel baseline views normalized per day; require at least 4 matched-style examples and ratio >= 1.5
performance_evidence.limitation: The expanded scan found five eligible recent Khan Academy AP Physics baseline videos, but zero of four exact-style matched examples. Rounded/heavy sentence-case Khan lesson lettering is adjacent, not the evaluated short uppercase Inter treatment. The baseline cannot create a candidate cohort, so normalization remains null and no font-style performance conclusion is attributable.

public_research_audit.normalization_formula: For each eligible video: 30-day-equivalent views = exact observed views / integer calendar age in days at capture × 30. Baseline = median of at least 4 eligible recent standard-length videos from the same channel. Candidate cohort result = median of at least 4 matched-style candidates’ 30-day-equivalent views / same-channel baseline median; approval requires >= 1.5.
missing_fields: Four current topic/audience-matched thumbnails using the proposed short uppercase neutral-sans treatment (observed 0 of 4); Khan Academy's rounded/heavy sentence-case lesson lettering remains a style non-match.
A matched-style candidate median; although five eligible recent same-channel Khan Academy AP Physics baseline videos were recorded, there is no matched candidate cohort to normalize against it.

A future controlled experiment: compare the current four-word uppercase Inter cue with a no-added-text variant and a short sentence-case neutral-sans variant, using the same owned KickLab gameplay frame, matched title/topic, randomized thumbnail exposure, and a fixed observation window; only run after explicit publishing/experiment authorization.
public_research_audit.conclusion: Expanded read-only public audit screened sports science, physics education, youth STEM, and gameplay-learning channels. Exact search exhaustion and channel scope are recorded per channel. No screened example met the exact style contract, so the matched sample remains 0 of 4 and the audit is Unscored. Five eligible Khan Academy AP Physics videos provide a current same-channel baseline only; they do not substitute for matched-style candidates. No paid scraping, uploads, publishing, or external writes occurred.

recovery_action: Future experiment hypothesis: after explicit publishing/experiment authorization, compare the four-word uppercase Inter cue, a no-added-text treatment, and a short sentence-case neutral-sans variant on the same owned KickLab gameplay frame and matched title/topic, using randomized thumbnail exposure and a fixed observation window. Keep typography Unscored until at least four exact-style examples and the unchanged 1.5× age-normalized same-channel threshold are met.
